name: "Summertime in Teyvat" Music Cover Challenge
description: Hello Travelers~ With the radiant glow of sunlight and the sea breeze caressing your face, summer has arrived in Teyvat! Let's use music to create unforgettable summer memories together! Interested in taking part? No problem! Choose a snippet or the whole fanmade summer theme song and create a cover with your unique voice and performance! You may also create your very own summer music video with scenes, characters, and game elements from Genshin Impact. Unleash your imagination and let the vibrant colors of summer bloom! Winners will have a chance to obtain an Alienware keyboard and Primogems. In addition, winning works will also be displayed on our official HoYoLAB account! https://open.spotify.com/album/0tYN296rSYlJBaB5VRQhfA
